_about: The one list of Cadence versions, newest first. qa/package-app.sh reads the app version and build from the first entry; qa/make-dmg.sh refuses any other version and stamps that entry's date and sha256; the site renders its version timeline and download details from this file (site/releases.mjs). Add a new entry at the top to start a release.

releases.title: Forgiving hands-free and a smoother install
highlights: Go hands-free by tapping Option twice, or tapping once and then holding. One tap finishes.
The pause allowed between taps follows your Mac's double-click speed, with extra room on top.
The pill says “tap again for hands-free” after the first tap, so you can see it registered.
Dictation Settings shows the microphone and voice filtering actually in use.
The app menu shows the installed version.
Homebrew installs without an admin password or a security warning.

releases.title: A cleaner widget logo
highlights: The desktop widget's logo drops its white plate, leaving the cobalt waveform and pink centre bar.

releases.title: Pink and cobalt, and a desktop widget
highlights: Optional desktop widget with today's and this week's words, streak, pace, time saved and all-time words.
Runs on macOS 14 Sonoma and later.

releases.title: Release-review fixes
highlights: A held Control-Option-Command-V or -Z no longer reaches the app you're typing in.
“Scratch that.” said as its own sentence takes back the whole sentence.
“The label is: delete that” stays as text, and “vitamin A a day” keeps its “A”.

releases.title: First public release
highlights: Hold Right Option, speak, release: on-device dictation into any app.
Two languages on two keys, with the multilingual Whisper model included.
Encrypted history, a personal dictionary and a time-saved dashboard.
